headline: Daily Check-In, from entry to detail
overview: Quick daily wellness check covering sleep quality, mood, energy, hydration, and movement. Build a holistic picture of your daily health patterns with a fast, approachable check-in that takes under a minute.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Quick daily check-in covering 5 key wellness dimensions
Track sleep quality, mood, energy, hydration, and movement
Identify correlations between different wellness factors
tips: Do your check-in at the same time each day — morning works well for sleep and energy, evening for a full-day review.
Look at your weekly trends rather than individual days to spot meaningful patterns in your health.
